name: Derivatives & Structured Products
description: Listed and OTC options, swaps, and structured notes: notionals, valuations, and greeks.

metrics.name: notional
metrics.description: Gross notional at a point in time

metrics.name: mark_to_market
metrics.description: Net present value at a point in time

metrics.name: delta
metrics.description: Value change per unit move in the underlying, in underlying-equivalent currency

metrics.name: vega
metrics.description: Value change per one-vol-point move in implied volatility

conventions.rule: Notional is size, not risk or value; never present notional as exposure.
State each greek's bump size and unit (e.g., vega per 1 vol point, delta in underlying-equivalent currency).
Greeks add only across positions on the same underlying and bump definition.

insight_rules.reason: Implied volatility is a price parameter, not an additive quantity.

caveats.text: OTC valuations are model-dependent; state the valuation source and date.

chart_conventions.rule: Show a volatility surface as a table or small multiples by expiry; avoid 3-D charts.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
